countries.reasoning: Based on USGS 2023 data, Russia is the largest palladium producer, accounting for roughly 40% of global production. Data is authoritative and up-to-date.

Canada's production figures from USGS and Canadian mining reports show around 10% of global palladium production, relatively stable output, very confident estimate.
USGS 2023 data shows the US produces roughly 6% of the world's palladium, primarily from the Stillwater mine; data reliable but production smaller.
Zimbabwe produces significant palladium quantities, around 4% globally, based on recent African mineral reports; slightly less comprehensive data than major producers.
